notes.title: The New Patch!
notes.notes:
We didn't rest on our laurels after releasing the full version of the game. Every day, we strive to improve our quality! Here are the results: 

-improved overall performance
-improved throwing of explosive objects
-improved AI behavior
-fixed unfog bug on the level selection
-fixed achievement bug on secret treasures
-fixed translations
-fixed font Japanese, Chinese and Russian fonts atlases
-fixed some visual glitches
-fixed some sound effects


Salute Veggie Friends! 
Red Limb Studio

notes.title: Kamikaze Veggies In The Full Version!
notes.notes:
Dear Friends!

We are pleased to announce that, after more than two years of development, "Kamikaze Veggies" is now available in full on Steam. Our game consists of 12 missions that will put your dexterity, stealth, patience, and logical thinking skills to the test! If you don't abandon ship, you'll be rewarded with an unforgettable adventure, 7 - 10 hours of gameplay, and a story as bizarre as we managed to create! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40617003/9dbd936a36447b276e26edd0668141e87fffb9d8.png



Cheers!
Red Limb Studio

notes.title: NEW CONTENT IN PATCH no. 2!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40617003/0d1e131db7dcb07f8a6f6a391f063d58aa4e30e4.png

Patch notes:
- added 4 new levels
- added a new character 
- added new weapons (smoke and chemical petard)
- added input mapper
- added 6 new achievements
- added a lot of small fixes and improvements
- improved level selection -
- improved performance on all quality settings
- price changed to 9.99$

notes.title: First patch!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40617003/98ff10af4096f8c622fb801ed376c25e4ae23599.png

Patch nr 1.

- improved performance on Level Selection
- improved overall performance, especially on low-quality settings and during destroying objects
- fixed low audio volume after the kamikaze blast
- fixed missing veggies discovery animation after starting a new game
- fixed not disappearing interaction info after returning to the menu (or Level Selection)
- fixed strange camera rotation when zooming at certain islands (Level Selection)
- fixed aiming speed on the joystick (a little bit faster)
- fixed input on mission panels ( axes, mouse move, or ESC button are not taken into account)
- fixed dithering after the kamikaze blast
- fixed some translations bugs
